the data presented in the paper are consistent with the results from the overall population and that the results from the subgroups are consistent with each other.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ixazomib, lenalidomde and dexamehtasone in the triplet regimen is effective in all patients with multiple myeloma.
in patients with relapse/refractory multiple Myeloma, the addition of ixazomim to lenalidomie/dexamethasone is effective and has an improved safety profile compared to lenalidimide/dexamethasome.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the efficacy of ixazomimib-Rd was consistent across subgroups of patients, regardless of prior treatment exposure with bortezombib or lenalidomde.
the efficacy and safety profile of ixazomibi-Rd is maintained regardless of prior therapy.
ixazomib is a novel proteasome inhibitor that can be administered orally and is active in patients with multiple myeloma who have failed prior therapies.
